exposure: Pregnant women using formulae that activate blood and remove stasis
Treatment group (Western medicine only vs. Western medicine/CHP)
Type of CHP formula (activate blood and remove stasis vs. purgative)
cohort: 47,153 pregnant women aged 18-50 years treated with tocolytics between 2001 and 2015 in Taiwan
finding: The combination of CHP and tocolytics was associated with a lower risk of preterm birth compared to tocolytics alone.
